main:1.text: ← N/A • • • • • List of Chapters • • • • • The Opening → The Hostage is the first chapter of Detroit: Become Human. This chapter has six different outcomes. On PlayStation 4, it was released as a free demo on April 24, 2018 worldwide. This chapter is from the perspective of Connor involving a deviant android named Daniel who takes Emma Phillips hostage after murdering her father John Phillips.

main:2.text: ← The Hostage • • • • • List of Chapters • • • • • Shades of Color → The Opening is the second chapter of Detroit: Become Human. This chapter has only one outcome. This chapter is from the perspective of Kara, who awakes at an android store after having her memory reset.

main:3.text: ← The Opening • • • • • List of Chapters • • • • • A New Home → Shades of Color is the third chapter of Detroit: Become Human. This chapter has only one outcome. This chapter is from the perspective of Markus, who is running an errand to pick up some paint, but encounters hatred toward androids along the entire way.

main:4.text: ← Shades of Color • • • • • List of Chapters • • • • • The Painter → A New Home is the fourth chapter of Detroit: Become Human. This chapter has only one outcome. Kara, who returns to the home of her owner after being repaired, is immediately sent to do chores around the house. She was allegedly hit by a car, but depending on the player's choices, she may learn that she was actually broken by Todd.

main:5.text: ← A New Home • • • • • List of Chapters • • • • • Partners → The Painter is the fifth chapter of Detroit: Become Human. This chapter has only one outcome. Markus returns home after picking up a package from Bellini Paints.

main:6.text: ← The Painter • • • • • List of Chapters • • • • • Stormy Night → Partners is the sixth chapter of Detroit: Become Human. This chapter has two different outcomes. Connor was sent by CyberLife to find Lieutenant Hank Anderson and accompany him in the investigation of the murder of Carlos Ortiz, committed by a deviant.

main:7.text: ← Partners • • • • • List of Chapters • • • • • Broken → Stormy Night is the seventh chapter of Detroit: Become Human. This chapter has nine different outcomes. This chapter picks up where A New Home left off. Todd has fallen asleep on the couch while Alice sits in the dining room, watching the street outside. Kara has prepared dinner for them and starts serving it at the table.

main:8.text: ← Stormy Night • • • • • List of Chapters • • • • • The Interrogation → Broken is the eighth chapter of Detroit: Become Human. This chapter has two different outcomes. This is the flowchart walkthrough for Broken, with 100% completion rate and all checkpoints. To the right is a video showing the in-game flowchart, while below is a text version for ease of use.

main:9.text: ← Broken • • • • • List of Chapters • • • • • Fugitives → The Interrogation is the ninth chapter of Detroit: Become Human. This chapter has four different outcomes. This chapter is from the perspective of Connor. For this chapter to be available, the player must have located the deviant in Partners. The fate of the android prisoner affects later chapters.

main:10.text: ← The Interrogation • • • • • List of Chapters • • • • • From the Dead → Fugitives is the tenth chapter of Detroit: Become Human. This chapter has three different outcomes. This chapter is from the perspective of Kara and it takes place after Stormy Night, provided players were successful in removing Alice from her home. Kara has the option of staying in a motel, car, or squatting.

main:11.text: ← Fugitives • • • • • List of Chapters • • • • • Waiting for Hank... → From the Dead is the eleventh chapter of Detroit: Become Human. This chapter has only one outcome. This chapter is from the perspective of Markus. After an argument between Markus, Carl and his son Leo in Carl's house, the police arrived and disassembled Markus as he was seen as the main perpetrator. His remains have been sent to the junkyard.

main:12.text: ← From the Dead • • • • • List of Chapters • • • • • On the Run → Waiting for Hank... is the twelfth chapter of Detroit: Become Human. This chapter has two different outcomes. This is the flowchart walkthrough for Waiting for Hank..., with 100% completion rate and all checkpoints.
